title: Multer
definition: Multer is a Node.js middleware for handling `multipart/form-data`, which is primarily used for uploading files. It adds a `body` object and a `file` or `files` object to the `req` object. The `body` object contains the values of the text fields of the form, while the `file` object contains the files uploaded via the form.
